name: Claude Skills Gov
description: Free, open-source Claude Skills purpose-built for local government work. 68 skills across 13 plugins covering council operations, clerk, finance, HR, planning, IT, legal, public safety, public works, economic development, parks, and library functions. TRAIGA-aware (Texas Responsible AI Governance Act), NIST AI RMF aligned, GovAI Coalition use case template compatible. MIT licensed.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install claude-skills-gov@claude-community` from `whitegloveai/claude-skills-gov`.

A free, open-source library of Claude Skills and Claude Code plugins built specifically for the day-to-day work of city, county, and special-district staff.
